rules: PRODUCTION_SPEC §12–§18; flat LIGHT backgrounds only (no black) — Honor pc-* frames have dark backgrounds: cut the watch out (rembg) onto paper/lavender/blush, never show the dark frame full-bleed; pc-1 is already on white. Whole real product; 1–3 words; 2-D objects next to the product; watermark below content; logo v5 end card; audio LOCKED (narrate.py + mix.sh). Length 50–58 s. No medical claims on screen; no Apple logo.
official_clips: none — Honor UK page has no video loops (checked page code 20 Nov)
palette_for_this_video: paper #FAF8F5 main; lavender #ECE8FB reveal/battery beats; blush #FBE7E2 price + THE CATCH; marigold sun/battery fills; ember accent for numbers

scenes.anchor: Honor just made a watch that hits fifty-five hundred nits

scenes.object: sun with rays pulsing behind the watch face; counter rolls 0 → 5,500
scenes.note: frame 1 must read instantly: watch + 5,500 NITS

scenes.object: question-mark pill pops beside the dial; tiny wrist outline under the watch

scenes.anchor: Pre-orders opened yesterday, in the UK and Europe

scenes.anchor: Here's the wild part. It's a two-layer OLED

scenes.object: two thin stacked layers slide apart under the screen like a sandwich, then snap together
sun object bright; gauge needle to 5,500 with small grey mark at 4,500 labelled 'whole screen'
scenes.note: show the 4,500 whole-panel figure small (honest fine print)

scenes.anchor: Up to eighteen days of battery

scenes.image: B pc-6 black on strap (crop text), centred

scenes.anchor: By our score? Sixty out of a hundred

logo v5 wordmark, k snaps upright (SPEC)

scenes.anchor: If you want a bright watch that lasts. Not if you need heart checks.
scenes.object: two stickers: sun+battery '✓ BRIGHT + LASTS', ecg '✗ HEART CHECKS'

scenes.anchor: Be honest. Would you trade ECG for eighteen days of battery?
